newsitem.title: USA: NYCE cotton lower, players await spec/hedge report.
newsitem.headline: NYCE cotton lower, players await spec/hedge report.

text.p: NYCE cotton futures stood lower at midday amid local liquidation of May contracts and a dearth of buying interest, market sources said.
First notice day for the spot month is April 24. Open interest fell 2,542 lots to 25,695 lots in May as of Friday's close, while second-position July gained 1,084 lots to 24,277 lots.
Analysts said the market will remain focused on liquidating May contracts throughout the week and could even see a rally as speculative short positions outweigh speculative longs.
Producer selling could limit gains around resistance seen between 76.00 and 77.00 cents a lb in May, however. Support was pegged at the contract low of 70.90 cents.
Technically, prices retreated after three consecutive days of closing firmer. Still, May managed to hold above last week's low of 70.90 cents ahead of Wednesday's spec/hedge report.
At 1205 EDT, May NYCE cotton was 0.76 cent lower at 71.60 cents, traded 72.50 to 71.48 cents. The back months stood down 0.85 to 0.46 cent.
